title: What could an A.J. Brown trade look like? A second-rounder could be achievable for the Eagles, but it may take patience

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: What could an A.J. Brown trade look like? A second-rounder could be achievable for the Eagles, but it may take patience
sources.description: One exec believed Brown was worth a "late first-round pick" from an AFC team. The four who fit that criteria best would be the Bills, Texans, Broncos and Patriots.
